title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“唔唔唔……”宁轻眉的身子十分敏感，哪怕刻意忍耐，还是不由自主发出娇哼。她只觉得陈青云的手指像是有魔力，给自己带来触电般的体验，就连脚趾都蜷缩起来。听到这声音，陈青云也亢奋起来。虽然屋内关着灯，但他还是能通过朦胧月光，看到那具雪白娇躯的轮廓。水蛇腰，蜜桃臀，大长腿……再加上她那高贵的身份，更是给人带来了前所未有的刺激。“轻眉姐，力度可以么？”陈青云一边施展独门手法，一边问道。“嗯啊~”宁轻眉发出婉转的鼻音。“你忍着点，我要加速了！”陈青云提醒道，随后加快了按摩的动作。“啊！”宁轻眉忍不住叫出了声，十根手指紧紧抓住了床单，身下的大床也摇晃起来。……一刻钟后。“轻眉姐，第一个疗程结束了！”陈青云收回了手，长舒一口气，又起身去开灯。只见宁轻眉已经钻进了被子里，但她俏脸红润，香汗淋漓，媚态横生，不经意间透出的风情，就足以令人沉沦。“青云，谢谢你……”宁轻眉感激道。做完了按摩，她只觉得体内暖洋洋的，说不出的舒服，明显是起作用了。“咦，怎么有股奇怪的味道？”陈青云抽了抽鼻子，随后低下头，却发现床单上有一摊水渍，甚至都流到了地板上。“这是……”陈青云先是一愣，随后立刻反应过来，这分明是宁轻眉的……这时，宁轻眉也涨红了脸，害羞的不知所措。这能怪她么？谁让陈青云的按摩手法太舒服了，让她都忍不住。“咳咳！”陈青云干咳一声，故意装傻：“轻眉姐，不好意思，是我刚才出了太多汗，我给你擦干净吧，否则待会你容易摔跤！”说着，他就掏出几张纸巾，半蹲下去想要擦拭。“咦，这是什么？”突然，他在床底下发现了一枚黑色纽扣样子的东西，却紧紧贴在床板上，还闪烁着蓝色的荧光。“窃听器？！”宁轻眉见到后，瞬间清醒过来，眼神透出锐利的寒芒。“轻眉姐，有人想要监听你？”陈青云也大吃一惊。

县里知道她住在这儿的，不在少数，但有胆子来安装窃听器的，却屈指可数。但不管是谁，这胆子未免也太大了！宁轻眉拿起那黑色纽扣，仔细研究了片刻，开口道：“这窃听器不是实时的，对方应该还没发现！”说着，她也松了口气。毕竟刚才陈青云给她抓凤筋，她发出的声音实在太羞人了，如果被外人拿捏住这个把柄，那就麻烦了。“轻眉姐，现在该怎么办？”陈青云问道。“引蛇出洞！”宁轻眉眸中闪烁着光芒，不徐不疾地开口：“这样吧，你这两天请个假，就守在公寓附近，看看有谁进出过这间屋子！咱们顺藤摸瓜，找出幕后主使！”“好！”陈青云立刻点头。……第二天。陈青云没有离开公寓，找了楼道的视野盲区，守株待兔。一直等到了下午五点多，有个戴着棒球帽和口罩，全副武装的黑衣青年，鬼鬼祟祟地来到公寓门口。他掏出一根铁丝插在钥匙孔，动作娴熟，三两下就打开了公寓的门，钻了进去。“鱼儿上钩了！”不远处，陈青云早已掏出手机，拍下了他开锁而入的画面。没过多久，这黑衣青年又走了出来，手中还拿着那枚窃听器，很快离开公寓，坐进了一辆吉普车。陈青云见状，连忙打了一辆出租车，跟了上去。很快，抵达了目的地，竟然是郊外的一家温泉度假村。那黑衣青年直奔露天区，周围有假山遮挡，十分隐秘。陈青云也换上泳裤，假装泡温泉，躺在不远处的一个泡池中。随后他又拨通电话，联系宁轻眉：“宁县长，我跟着嫌疑人来到了温泉度假村，在户外8号泡池。不过，他应该就是个小虾米，背后的主使还没现身！”“你等着，我马上过来！”宁轻眉说道。半小时后。“陈秘书……”陈青云突然听到身后，有人喊自己的名字。他回头一看，顿时眼睛都看直了。只见宁轻眉一改往日的端庄，竟然换上了泳衣，虽然不是比基尼，而是保守的黑色连体衣，但依旧性感十足。她虽然30岁了，但保养的极好，娇嫩的肌肤吹弹可破，就像少女一样。“宁县长，你……”陈青云只觉得口干舌燥，眼睛都不知道该往哪儿看。“我这么穿，很奇怪么？”宁轻眉双手捂住胸口，俏脸泛红，有些害羞。“不……是太好看了！你如果去当泳衣模特儿，那其他人都得下岗了！”陈青云由衷的夸赞道。听到这话，宁轻眉面露喜色，但很快就追问道：“对了，嫌疑人在哪儿？”“就在那儿！”

"Uh huh..." Ning Qingmei's body was very sensitive, and even if she tried to endure it, she still moaned involuntarily.She only felt that Chen Qingyun's fingers seemed to have magic power, giving her an electric shock-like experience, and even her toes curled up.Hearing this voice, Chen Qingyun also became excited.Although the lights were turned off in the room, he could still see the outline of the snow-white body through the dim moonlight.Water snake waist, peach buttocks, long legs... Coupled with her noble status, it brought unprecedented stimulation to people."Sister Qingmei, is the strength okay?" Chen Qingyun asked while using his unique technique."Yeah~" Ning Qingmei made a gentle nasal sound."Be patient, I'm going to speed up!" Chen Qingyun reminded, and then accelerated the massage."Ah!" Ning Qingmei couldn't help shouting, her ten fingers tightly grasping the sheets, and the big bed underneath her shook....a quarter of an hour later."Sister Qingmei, the first course of treatment is over!" Chen Qingyun retracted his hand, breathed a sigh of relief, and stood up to turn on the light.I saw that Ning Qingmei had already slipped into the quilt, but her pretty face was rosy, dripping with sweat, and she was charming. The charm she revealed inadvertently was enough to make people fall in love."Qingyun, thank you..." Ning Qingmei said gratefully.After the massage, she felt warm and indescribably comfortable inside her body. It was obviously working."Hey, why is there a strange smell?" Chen Qingyun sniffed, then lowered his head, only to find a pool of water stains on the sheets, which even flowed to the floor."This is..." Chen Qingyun was stunned for a moment, and then immediately realized that this was clearly Ning Qingmei's... At this time, Ning Qingmei's face was also flushed, and she was embarrassed and at a loss.Can you blame her?Who made Chen Qingyun's massage techniques so comfortable that she couldn't help it."Ahem!" Chen Qingyun coughed dryly and pretended to be stupid: "Sister Qingmei, I'm sorry, I sweated too much just now. Let me wipe it off for you, otherwise you will fall easily later!" As he said, he took out a few tissues and squatted down to wipe them."Hey, what is this?" Suddenly, he found a black button-like thing under the bed, but it was tightly attached to the bed board and flashing blue fluorescence."Eavesdropping device?!" Ning Qingmei suddenly woke up after seeing it, her eyes showing a sharp cold light."Sister Qingmei, someone wants to spy on you?" Chen Qingyun was also shocked.

There were many people in the county who knew she lived here, but there were only a handful of people who had the guts to install bugs.But no matter who it is, this is too courageous!Ning Qingmei picked up the black button, studied it carefully for a moment, and said, "This bug is not real-time. The other party probably hasn't noticed it yet!" As she said that, she also breathed a sigh of relief.After all, the sound she made when Chen Qingyun grabbed her phoenix muscle just now was so embarrassing. If an outsider took advantage of this, it would be troublesome."Sister Qingmei, what should we do now?" Chen Qingyun asked."Lead the snake out of the hole!" Ning Qing's eyebrows flashed and she spoke slowly: "Let's take a leave of absence for the next two days and stay near the apartment to see who has been in and out of this room! Let's follow the clues and find out who is behind the scenes!" "Okay!" Chen Qingyun nodded immediately.……the next day.Chen Qingyun did not leave the apartment, but found a blind spot in the corridor and waited.Waiting until about five o'clock in the afternoon, a young man in black, wearing a baseball cap and a mask, and armed to the teeth, sneakily came to the door of the apartment.He took out a piece of wire and inserted it into the keyhole. With skillful movements, he opened the apartment door in a few clicks and got in."The fish is hooked!" Not far away, Chen Qingyun had already taken out his mobile phone and took a picture of him unlocking the door and entering.Not long after, the young man in black came out again, still holding the bug in his hand, and quickly left the apartment and got into a jeep.Seeing this, Chen Qingyun quickly took a taxi and followed him.Soon, we arrived at our destination, which turned out to be a hot spring resort in the suburbs.The young man in black went straight to the open-air area, which was surrounded by rockery and was very hidden.Chen Qingyun also put on swimming trunks, pretended to take a hot spring bath, and lay in a pool not far away.Then he made a phone call and contacted Ning Qingmei: "County Magistrate Ning, I followed the suspect to the hot spring resort and soaked in the outdoor pool No. 8. However, he must be just a little shrimp, and the mastermind behind it has not shown up yet!" "Just wait, I'll be here right away!" Ning Qingmei said.Half an hour later."Secretary Chen..." Chen Qingyun suddenly heard someone calling his name from behind him.When he looked back, his eyes suddenly widened.I saw Ning Qingmei changed from her usual modesty and put on a swimsuit. Although it was not a bikini, but a conservative black one-piece, it was still sexy.Although she is 30 years old, she takes excellent care of herself, and her delicate skin can be broken by blows, just like a girl."County Magistrate Ning, you..." Chen Qingyun felt his mouth was dry and his eyes didn't know where to look."Is it weird that I'm wearing this?" Ning Qingmei covered her chest with her hands, her pretty face turned red and she was a little shy."No...it's so beautiful! If you become a swimsuit model, everyone else will have to be laid off!" Chen Qingyun praised sincerely.Hearing this, Ning Qingmei looked happy, but quickly asked: "By the way, where is the suspect?" "It's right there!"
